statement.excerpt: LLMs may eventually be replaced by better technologies, but for now, they aren’t going anywhere, even if some of the commercial purveyors go out of business.
statement.document_title: The desperate race to save Generative AI

from_speaker: even if some of the commercial purveyors go out of business
may eventually be replaced by better technologies
our_interpretation: The forecast concerns continued availability of LLMs as a technology, not survival of every provider.
For now supplies no calendar deadline. No fixed duration is added.
Even if is a robustness clause: the forecast asserts persistence whether or not some providers fail. It is not an antecedent that must happen before the basic persistence prediction applies.
The possible eventual replacement is a concession, not a separate firm prediction.
criteria.support_condition: LLMs remain available throughout the intended near-term period, including any relevant provider exits. The source does not define when that period ends.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A verified disappearance of usable LLMs across providers and independently deployable releases occurs within the intended near term.
